_doc: Nebula AI bundled model manifest — single authority for the pinned HuggingFace model URL, SHA-256, filename, and metadata. Consumed at build time by stage_nebula_model() in scripts/build-iso.sh and at boot time indirectly via the MANIFEST.sha256 generated from this source. DEC-PHASE10-002 (model selection: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 Q4_K_M, Apache-2.0), DEC-PHASE10-008 (HF staging + ORIONX_MODEL_LOCAL air-gap fallback). Mirror swap from TheBloke (gated) to bartowski (non-gated) per closes #60 — DEC-PHASE10-002 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 Q4_K_M model choice preserved; same Apache 2.0 license.
_integrity_note: model_sha256 is 'TBD-VERIFY-AT-DOWNLOAD' — the first successful build will compute the real SHA-256 from the downloaded file and a follow-up commit will pin the verified value. This is the standard trust-on-first-use pattern with subsequent integrity lockdown (DEC-PHASE10-008). Once verified, the SHA-256 must be a 64-char lowercase hex string. model_filename (lowercase) is the destination name written by wget -O in stage_nebula_model(); source URL filenames may differ in case (bartowski uses titlecase) — the manifest filename field governs the on-disk name, not the URL.
_size_note: model_size_bytes is the expected on-disk size of the Q4_K_M GGUF (approximately 4.4 GB). The ISO size jumps from ~1.8 GB (rc4) to ~6 GB with this model bundled (DEC-PHASE10-003 target). A WARN (not fail) is emitted by build-iso.sh if the final ISO exceeds 7 GB (DEC-PHASE10-012).
_mirror_note: Primary: bartowski/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3-GGUF — post-TheBloke community standard for GGUF mirrors, non-gated for Apache 2.0 models. Fallback: MaziyarPanahi/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3-GGUF — also non-gated. Both verified non-gated as of iter-4 (CI run 27248652260 failed on TheBloke gating). hf_commit_sha removed — no pinned SHA from bartowski yet; pin in same follow-up commit that pins model_sha256 per #56.
